objective: Bind validated node-attempt receipts into terminal and fan-in gate evidence without transferring completion authority
prefetch: Inspect terminal gate naming and status rules
Inspect DAG blocker and cycle semantics
constraints: Receipt path and hash must match
Dependency order and fan-in are mandatory
Failed or stale evidence never advances
acceptance_criteria: Opted-in terminal gates validate receipt status freshness proof and dependencies
model_tier_reason: A gate-validation error can create dishonest completion
escalation_triggers: Unrelated gate history must be rewritten
